description: Reperes crues 76 Min Transition Ecologique 2020 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département de la Seine-Maritime. Ce fichier est une extraction pour la Seine-Maritime des données de la plateforme nationale collaborative des sites et repères de crues ( Mise en place par Vigicrues, la Plateforme collaborative des repères de crues a pour but de recenser l'ensemble des repères de crues sur le territoire français, quelle que soit leur nature. Coverage: Département de la Seine-Maritime. The publisher named on the listing is Département de la Seine-Maritime. Its keywords include crues, geospatial, environnement, risques. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV, KML, WEB PAGE, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2020-09-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
